items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: So he say, 'Would you like to teach me? You know?' ... 'You teach me and I'll teach you, you know.'

ctx.x: But he came back, and he was explaining to me how to do such and such a step, how to be on the beat, how to be on time with it. I liked that. And I liked that. Everything I would say "I like that, I like that, you know, see. I was learning. I could learn quickly, quick learner, you could call it.

So then one day, one afternoon there, here come Tiger Flowers walking across the street. Now, he was popular. He was the lightweight champion of the world at that time, Tiger Flowers, and he lived right just around the corner on Irving Street. And he says, he came walking right over across the street where we were sitting at, you know, and he said --
